posts.title: Image Info VS Code Extension
posts.description: VS Code’s built-in image preview is handy, but it only tells you the dimensions and file size in the status bar. When I’m working with images I often want to know more: is this JPEG progressive? Does it have a color profile? How big is this SVG once it’s gzipped? posts.title: Image Optimizer Plus for Windows
posts.description: On my Mac I’ve been using ImageOptim for years. Drop some images onto it, wait a second, and they’re smaller. No settings to fiddle with and no worrying about whether the images still look the same. On Windows I never found anything quite as simple, so I made one: Image Optimizer Plus.
